contract_notes: All rows in each named table participate. Every original CSV remains in case. There are no implicit filters, deduplication, fuzzy matching, tolerances, rounding, currency conversions, payment allocation or tariff calculations.

source/target keys are ordered declared column names. Without key_mapping, key types must agree positionally. With mapping, columns must match corresponding side key types; every participating source key requires exactly one valid mapping and one source-to-target identity. Duplicate/colliding mapping rows remain unresolved.

Field kinds: text, integer, decimal, date, boolean. Nondecimal kinds require matching original declared type. Decimal accepts integer/decimal inputs and exact rational multiplier/divisor, optional additive offset; transformations need explicit reference whenever nonidentity. Tolerance is required and nonnegative. No round-to-match.

dimensions lists nondecimal field IDs; they must match and be nonnull before any decimal-field comparison. All full-population totals are grouped by these exact dimensions in disk-backed indexes and streamed totals.jsonl/totals.csv; no group cap or giant embedded summary. Incomplete rows retain eligible subtotal plus explicit uncomputed count.

A paired group needs exactly one valid source and target row. Every compared field must be MATCHED or explicitly allowed BOTH_NULL to classify MATCHED. Source/target-only rows, invalid/unkeyed rows, duplicate groups and crosswalk problems are fully emitted with original record references. Ambiguous groups emit one comparison per original member plus complete group counts.

Comparisons are streamed as rows.jsonl, rows.csv and indexed comparisons.sqlite. result.json holds complete pair definitions, all aggregate-total descriptors/source-quality, output hashes/counts and paths; it never embeds the full row population. The full indexed SQLite member is included and verified alongside its exact JSONL exports.

Review server serves only an explicitly selected private case on 127.0.0.1, through a generated unpredictable access token. No public bind or upload mutation. Browser retains no customer values in external services. Case export is prepacked from verified immutable inputs/results/source.

The result summary pairs[].totals is {count,first_total_id,last_total_id,status_counts}. Each paged/streamed total has total_id,pair,dimensions,field,source:{sum,rows,uncomputed_rows},target:{sum,rows,uncomputed_rows},difference,status,meaning. Source/target sum and difference are exact fraction objects with numerator,denominator,decimal display. Crosswalk issues are full comparison records, classification CROSSWALK_ISSUE; counts remain in pair.crosswalk_issue_counts.
